Preferred Skills - Experience supporting large-scale industrial, data center, manufacturing, utility, or other mission-critical infrastructure projects. - Experience developing conceptual and schematic design models in addition to construction documentation. - Strong understanding of multidisciplinary MEP coordination, equipment clearances, routing zones, and constructability considerations. - Experience with Autodesk Construction Cloud, BIM 360, Navisworks, Revizto, Bluebeam, Civil 3D, ArcGIS, Dynamo, Python, or Autodesk Platform Services. - Experience supporting model automation, asset management, data extraction, quantity takeoffs, and design reporting. - Experience coordinating with internal engineering organizations, external consultants, contractors, and owner representatives. - Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Architectural, and Structural engineering teams. Dear Pfizer Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Quality Control Raw Materials Sampling Associate opportunity with Pfizer at Pfizer.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. Best,
Celina Lin

You'll work at the intersection of operations, logistics, and analytics—getting deep into the details of how catering deliveries actually play out on the ground, forming hypotheses about what's breaking, and running small, fast tests to find what works before we scale it. This is early-stage, hands-on problem solving, not optimizing a machine that already runs. You will report into the Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations for DoorDash for Business and can work remotely or hybrid depending preference. You're excited about this opportunity because you will… Own Dasher quality for catering: Take end-to-end ownership of delivery quality for catering—on-time arrival, accurate drop-off and setup, and a clean handoff—so customers can trust every order. Build net new logistics: Figure out how catering and deliveries should actually work—Dasher selection, batching, timing, equipment, and handoff—by testing different approaches and learning what holds up in the real world. Get into the details: Dig into individual deliveries, talk to Dashers and customers, and trace exactly where things break down—then turn those root causes into concrete operational fixes. Use AI to optimize how we operate : Build the automated workflows that show where catering deliveries break down—and lean on AI to turn slow, manual analysis and one-off fixes into repeatable processes the team can scale. Influence the Product Roadmap: Translate what you learn on the ground into clear product and operational recommendations that make catering delivery more reliable. jobs.title: Manager, PDS Data Domain
jobs.description: At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. Position Summary Bristol Myers Squibb is seeking a manager to advance data governance and data quality within PDS, helping business functions manage and use data as a trusted, reusable business asset. The role engages business and functional stakeholders, process owners, data owners and stewards to understand business needs and build alignment on governance initiatives, data standards, ownership, quality expectations and measurable outcomes. Working with data engineering and technology teams, the Manager translates agreed priorities into actionable requirements, coordinates data-quality issue resolution and supports the delivery and adoption of governed data products and analytics using Databricks and enterprise data lakes. The Manager communicates the business value of well-governed, high-quality data and helps users apply reliable insights in operational decisions. The Manager owns assigned workstreams and deliverables, with strategic direction and prioritization provided by the Senior Manager or Data Domain Lead. Key Responsibilities – Data Quality and Governance · Work with data owners and stewards to document critical data elements, definitions, ownership, data-quality rules and acceptance thresholds. · Support metadata, lineage, access, privacy and data-quality controls required for governed and fit-for-purpose data products. · Investigate data issues with business and technical teams; document root cause, resolution and prevention actions. · Promote consistent governance practices across data lake, Databricks and downstream data-product delivery. Business Analysis and Adoption · Analyze operational pain points and translate them into prioritized data-product backlog items. · Prepare demonstrations, user guidance, training materials and adoption communications. · Collect user feedback and product measures to support continuous improvement. · Help users discover available data, understand product definitions and apply data consistently in business decisions. Data Platform and Product Execution Support end-to-end delivery of data products and analytics for an assigned PDS domain or use case, from discovery and requirements through testing, release and adoption. Work with data engineering teams to use enterprise data lake and Databricks capabilities for data ingestion, transformation, curation and consumption. Gather and document business requirements, data definitions, user stories, acceptance criteria, source-to-target needs and process impacts. Help define reusable data products with clear consumers, business value, ownership, service expectations and measurable success criteria. Coordinate working sessions with business experts, data stewards, data engineers and technology teams. Track actions, risks, dependencies, decisions and delivery milestones; escalate issues promptly. Collaboration and Ways of Working · Engage business and functional stakeholders, process owners, data owners and stewards to understand business needs, communicate the value of data governance and data quality, and build alignment on priorities, ownership and expected outcomes. · Facilitate cross-functional discussions to agree on data standards, data-quality expectations and remediation priorities; coordinate with business and technology teams to implement agreed actions and drive adoption of data governance initiatives. · Contribute to a practical, inclusive and data-driven culture within PDS. Qualifications & Experience Required · Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, life sciences, data science, information systems or a related field. · 5 to 7 years of relevant experience across data governance, data quality, data analytics or digital delivery, partnering with business functions such as operations, manufacturing, supply chain or quality to establish and use trusted data as a business asset; regulated-industry experience is preferred. · 2+ years of practical experience delivering data or analytics solutions using Databricks and enterprise data lakes, applying governance standards and data-quality controls. Ability to engage business stakeholders, translate their needs into actionable requirements and clearly explain how well-governed, high-quality data enables reliable insights, reuse and business value. · Experience with SAP master data, including business-partner, material, vendor, customer or other relevant master-data domains. · Experience with data-quality profiling, rule definition, monitoring, issue management and root-cause analysis. · Experience with data-governance practices such as stewardship, ownership, metadata, lineage, access controls and critical-data-element management. · Knowledge of operational systems such as SAP, Veeva, laboratory information management systems or supply-chain planning platforms. · Familiarity with good practice requirements and regulated data controls for applicable domains. · Practical experience working with enterprise data lakes, including data ingestion, transformation, curation and consumption patterns. · Hands-on or delivery experience with Databricks, including SQL, notebooks, workflows or jobs; familiarity with governed catalogs and layered data architecture is expected. · Experience defining or delivering data products, including requirements, ownership, quality expectations, user acceptance and adoption measures. · Experience documenting requirements, coordinating cross-functional work and supporting testing, training or adoption. · Ability to translate business questions into clear data needs, user stories and acceptance criteria. · Working knowledge of SQL and modern data-platform concepts; exposure to Python, visualization or data-quality tools is helpful. · Clear communication, organization, collaboration and problem-solving skills. What Sets This Role Apart · Platform-to-value impact : Connects enterprise data lake and Databricks capabilities to practical PDS outcomes. · Data governance and quality mindset: Transforms data into a valuable asset by identifying gaps and improving ways of working through a data-quality-focused approach. · Trusted data foundation : Connects data governance through clear ownership and standards with data quality through measurable controls and issue resolution, enabling reliable business decisions. · Data-product mindset : Builds reusable, governed data assets around clear users, value and adoption. · End-to-end exposure : Contributes from discovery and data-quality definition through testing, launch and adoption. · Collaborative role : Connects business, governance and technology teams around shared outcomes. · Growth pathway : Builds the experience needed to lead larger data domains and product portfolios over time. jobs.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role A connected Claude is the difference between a general-purpose chatbot and a real coworker. We're building the connected enterprise on three fronts: zero-touch activation, a thriving connector ecosystem, and an enterprise control plane that lets organizations adopt with confidence. We own the path from discovering a connector to using it every day: default and suggested connectors, one-click setup, connector requests, and the identity and admin pieces that remove setup friction for a whole organization at once. You'll be a technical leader who owns activation end to end, from the moment someone sees a connector to their first successful use of it. You'll also help to shape the foundations that help the connector ecosystem grow, and the governance controls that make it safe at enterprise scale. You'll partner closely with product, design and data science, and carry real ownership over what we ship next. What you'll do Own connector activation end to end: measure the funnel from discovery to first use to habit, find the biggest drop-offs, and fix them Build and run experiments on default connectors, in-product suggestions, connector requests and onboarding flows Make setup close to zero-touch, building on open standards like Cross App Access (XAA) and the MCP authorization spec so one approval can turn a connector on for everyone Improve the connectors people reach for most, like Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, so the first experience works and keeps working Lay platform foundations for the connector ecosystem: reusable building blocks that make every new connector easier to launch, discover and activate Build out the enterprise control plane: admin controls and governance (domain restrictions, labels, permissions) that help security teams say yes faster instead of blocking rollout Partner with product, design, data science and sales to turn usage data and customer feedback into priorities Set technical direction and standards for the team, mentor other engineers, and lead with influence rather than authority Minimum Qualifications Have shipped growth or activation work: onboarding flows, funnels, experimentation, and measuring what actually moves usage Are comfortable with authorization and identity (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SSO), enough to make setup flows simple without cutting corners Have built on large platform APIs (Microsoft Graph, Google Workspace or similar) and can debug failures on both sides of the boundary Have built platform or ecosystem surfaces that other teams or developers rely on, and care about durable, well-designed APIs Understand what enterprise admins and security teams need from policy, permissions and governance at scale Use data and user research to decide what to build, and can explain the tradeoffs to product and design partners Drive cross-team and cross-company alignment to ship, with influence over authority Preferred Qualifications Have 8+ years of software engineering experience, ideally with 2+ years at a Staff or equivalent technical leadership level Contributed to or implemented emerging auth standards (IETF OAuth drafts, MCP authorization) Experience with data governance or information protection (sensitivity labels, DLP) Built admin consoles or policy engines for multi-tenant SaaS Run growth experiments on activation funnels Built AI products or agent tool integrations (MCP) Helped grow a developer or partner ecosystem around a platform The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $405,000 — $485,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. jobs.description: Natera is seeking a Lead Bioinformatics Scientist to join our Oncology Bioinformatics team and support the development, validation, and clinical application of our NGS-based assays. The ideal candidate has a strong background in data analysis for wet lab support and extensive experience with NGS data, with a focus on building solutions for oncology applications. In this role, you will shape the analytical validation strategy for an NGS assay, design and analyze feasibility and performance evaluation studies, and generate real-world evidence demonstrating its clinical utility. You will work with interdisciplinary teams to turn complex, multi-source data into actionable recommendations, supporting research, product development, validation, regulatory submissions, clinical studies, and scientific publications. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: Lead the analytical validation strategy for an NGS-based assay, including designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting feasibility and performance evaluation studies (e.g., PPA and LoD) with bench scientists and biostatisticians. Drive real-world evidence (RWE) studies that demonstrate the clinical utility of for therapy selection and patient management, from cohort selection through analysis of plasma mutation calls. Build rapid prototypes and pipelines for custom analyses that integrate data from multiple Natera products. Develop algorithms and tools to support new products, including contributions to the production bioinformatics pipeline. Act as an internal technical consultant on bioinformatics methodology for other functional groups. Work closely with assay development, engineering, biostatistics, clinical, commercial, regulatory, and lab operations teams. Contribute to regulatory submissions, clinical study reports, and scientific publications. QUALIFICATIONS Master’s degree in bioinformatics (or a related field) with 10 years of post-graduate experience, or PhD with 5 years of post-graduate experience (preferred). KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES: Expert knowledge of bioinformatics tools for NGS, including sequencing QC and secondary analysis such as variant calling. Experience with WES/WGS/targeted sequencing of tissue and cfDNA, and with somatic variant calling (SNVs, indels, CNVs, fusions) on these data. Working knowledge of statistical methods for assay performance evaluation, and ability to collaborate with biostatisticians on study design. Strong programming and scripting skills in Python, R, and shell. Fluency in exploratory data analysis and visualization of complex datasets, with the ability to distill observations into actionable recommendations. Deep understanding of NGS workflows from sample extraction to sequencing, and the ability to link bioinformatic findings to wet lab root causes. Ability to communicate effectively with wet lab groups and cross-functional partners, and to explain technical concepts clearly. Ability to work independently while managing multiple objectives and timelines. Comfort adapting quickly when experimental results change the plan, and a desire to work in a fast-paced environment with high impact in a small team. PREFERRED: Experience supporting regulated or clinical-grade assay development (e.g., CLIA/CAP, FDA submissions), including analytical validation studies. Familiarity with clinical genomics, including oncogenic drivers, actionable biomarkers, targeted therapies, and variant interpretation in oncology. Experience with translational or real-world data analysis, including integrating clinical and genomic data. jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Ads Forecasting & Scenarios
jobs.description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . The opportunity Build the machine learning capabilities that help advertisers understand what they could achieve on Reddit and make better investment decisions. You will lead models that estimate how campaign outcomes could change with different budgets, bids, audiences, creative performance, or objectives. The work connects supply and demand forecasting, audience availability, response prediction, and marketplace simulation to help advertisers compare alternatives and recognize valuable opportunities they may be missing. This is a hands-on technical leadership role with ownership of modeling direction, evaluation standards, and reusable production capabilities across advertiser planning and recommendations. What you’ll do Lead forecasting and scenario modeling. Translate advertiser questions into models of delivery, reach, performance, and investment tradeoffs. Set technical direction and guide execution across the team. Connect inventory, demand, and response. Combine forecasts of available advertising opportunities, audience activity, marketplace competition, and predicted response to estimate achievable delivery and performance. Estimate outcomes under alternative choices. Develop models that account for changes in budget, bid, audience, and optimization objective, including interactions among these choices, auction dynamics, and campaign constraints. Quantify unrealized opportunity. Incorporate creative-performance estimates from partner teams to assess how stronger creative could have improved campaign results. Translate those inputs into potential gains in delivery, efficiency, or advertiser value. Build models that generalize. Apply probabilistic forecasting, multitask learning, transfer learning, hierarchical modeling, or related approaches to handle sparse segments, cold start, delayed feedback, and changing conditions. Establish trustworthy comparisons. Evaluate numerical accuracy, calibration, uncertainty, and cohort-level performance. Define supported scenarios and identify when additional evidence or experimentation is needed. Close the learning loop. Compare recorded predictions with mature outcomes, diagnose systematic errors, and validate scenario estimates through experiments and observed results. Own production delivery and technical leadership. Partner with engineers on reliable training, serving, monitoring, and iteration. Lead designs, mentor engineers, and collaborate with Product, Data Science, Ads Delivery, Audience, and Creative teams. What we’re looking for A track record of developing and shipping predictive ML systems in advertising, marketplaces, recommendations, search, demand forecasting, or similarly complex domains. Strong foundations in statistical learning, probability, and optimization, with experience modeling large-scale behavioral or transactional data. Depth in one or more relevant areas: probabilistic or hierarchical forecasting, calibrated conversion/value prediction, multitask or transfer learning, delayed-feedback or survival modeling, or response modeling . Strong judgment in evaluation, including temporal validation, calibration, segment-level performance, and the assumptions required to estimate outcomes under changed conditions. Experience addressing sparse observations, cold start, seasonality, distribution shift, selection bias, or partially observed labels. Strong programming and software engineering skills, including experience building and operating production ML systems. Demonstrated ability to lead ambiguous technical initiatives, make practical tradeoffs, and develop other engineers. Preferred experience Complementary depth in one or more of: Demand, supply, and inventory forecasting: Advertising inventory, marketplace demand, traffic, retail demand, or capacity forecasting. Relevant methods include probabilistic time-series models, hierarchical/global forecasting, external-signal modeling, and multi-horizon prediction. Auction and investment modeling: Auction simulation or replay, conditional win-rate and price models, bid/budget response curves, or constrained optimization. Scenario evaluation: Counterfactual or off-policy evaluation, sensitivity analysis, uncertainty propagation, or composition of multiple predictive models. Reach and audience estimation: Population and overlap estimation, probabilistic reach/frequency models, sampling correction, or saturation modeling. Advanced predictive methods: Mixture-of-experts, distributional or quantile prediction, temporal sequence models, or state-space models. What success looks like Accurate and calibrated forecasts across priority advertiser populations; credible comparisons of supported campaign alternatives; reusable capabilities across planning and recommendations; and evidence that advertisers identify valuable opportunities and make better investment decisions. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors . cold_email.subject: Interest in AI Engineer — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Illumina Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the AI Engineer opportunity with Illumina at Illumina.

I am especially interested in building scalable data systems that let research and clinical teams use biological data reliably. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, I have built API-driven and Snakemake-based pipelines, automated SQL workflows, and worked across both scientific and software contexts.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.description: WHY HARVEY At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. ROLE OVERVIEW We’re hiring a Manager, Learning & Certification Architecture to define how customers learn Harvey and to build the system that produces that learning at scale. You’ll own the learning and certification strategy across Harvey Academy, the Help Center and in-product education: who we teach, what each persona needs to be able to do, and which format fits each learning problem. Harvey ships new product every week, so you’ll also design the agentic workflows that draft content from product sources, set the quality bar and review steps every piece passes before it publishes. This is a hands-on leadership role: you’ll build content yourself while guiding a team of learning experience designers and a certification developer. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build a leveled, persona-based curriculum for associates, partners, knowledge managers, in-house counsel and administrators, with clear outcomes and assessments from first use to certified practitioner. - Define what Harvey certification means: competencies, exam design, pass standards, recertification, and how credentials are issued and verified. - Diagnose each learning need, choose the right format (Help Center article, in-product walkthrough, video, course or exam), and produce content yourself in writing, video and audio. - Design the agentic production workflows, including the instructional standards the agents are built on and the review gates and rubrics content must pass before it publishes. - Own publishing, maintenance and localization across surfaces, working with Engineering and Localization so each product release reaches every asset it affects. - Guide the designers and certification developer, and work with Product, Product Marketing, Customer Success, Support and Legal Engineering on release readiness and learning success metrics. WHAT YOU HAVE - 5+ years in learning experience design, instructional design or learning architecture for a technical product, including 2+ years leadership experience. - A track record of building a leveled, persona-based curriculum or certification program from scratch, including competency models, assessments and pass standards. - Hands-on production skill in at least two of: long-form writing, video or audio. - Fluency with AI tools in your own work, and experience designing workflows where models draft and people review. - Experience running a CMS (e.g., Sanity) and and an LMS (e.g. Skilljar), and using learning data to set priorities and measure results. - Experience teaching lawyers or other professionals, or familiarity with CLE accreditation, is a plus. cold_email.subject: Interest in Clinical Lab Associate — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Natera Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Clinical Lab Associate opportunity with Natera at Natera.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.description: At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. Summary: The position requires an experienced Developer with a strong focus on cloud native services, DevOps, Automation and creating reusable platforms. The ideal candidate should have expertise in designing complex systems, self-service user and admin portals and cloud-based services, with expert-level experience in AWS and additional experience in GCP or Azure being a plus. The candidate must be able to develop, analyze and design end to end Cloud-Native solutions that automate complex tasks and simplify user experience. The candidate should have a deep understanding of DevOps/Infrastructure-As-Code (IaC) delivery models, Cloud: Network, Security, Application architecture, and usage models. The candidate must be experienced with Agile, DevOps and test-oriented system design philosophies, as well as ability to interface with other teams that may need education on cloud and DevOps best practices. Skills - Must Have The ideal candidate must be a strong developer and have experience using AWS services beyond just EC2s and Databases. Expertise in serverless, managed services, API-Governance, Basic Networking is required. Strong understanding of basic cloud networking is required to assist in troubleshooting and designing optimized solutions. The candidate must have hands-on experience with cloud projects and will be expected to demonstrate the ability to deliver quality script, code and test suites. Must have working experience with deep-dive HTTPS troubleshooting, Must have lots of experience with REST API and design, GraphQL and React/CSS front end. Skilled with JavaScript, NodeJS and Python, especially in Lambda and Beanstalk environment. Coach and develop other employees and be a technology leader and resolve difficult technical roadblocks. The candidate should have demonstrated knowledge or experience with CloudFormation at scale and reuse, and the ability to influence multiple workstreams with reusable IaC components. The candidate should also have experience in developing multi-region, serverless solutions on AWS and addressing all non-functional and AWS Well-Architected concerns in the design. Must be able to design for end-user simplicity while ensuring the system can handle complexity and exceptions internally. The candidate should have experience in breaking down projects into MVP and Agile deliverables, delivering complex end systems incrementally. Must be able to design for disaster recovery in IaaS Cloud platform and possess strong scripting skills, such as Python, Bash, Ruby, Perl, PowerShell, SSM, etc. Must have experience with managing substantial numbers of cloud accounts consistently using automation. Cloud SDK, CLI and scripting hands-on knowledge is necessary. Good listener and communicator. Strong verbal, non-verbal diagramming, and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across internal and external organizations Experience with working and building an automated build-pipeline, continuous integration, and continuous deployment. Experience with source code control repositories In-depth understanding of Interface-Contracts, Loosely Coupled designs and simplifying solutions and reducing TCO for the end-to-end picture. Skills - Preferred Experience creating and maintaining an Enterprise Internal Development Platform or equivalent highly reusable components or services. Prior success in automating a real-world problem from manual parts Expertise in Cloud security and access models Management of continuous integration servers like AWS Code Pipeline, Code Build. Familiarity with monitoring tools Strong practical Linux and Windows-based server configuration, CLI, Script and automation skills, particularly in a Cloud environment. Skilled with producing well-designed UX with self-service solutions using Reacts GUI using REST/GraphQL API securely is a big plus. Experience with seamless/automated build scripts used for release management across environments. AWS Service Catalog experience is a big plus. Experience with automated testing and unit test tools and processes is a big plus Experience building and supporting serverless automation in AWS Expertise in PaaS, and SaaS methodologies, network integration and controls Experience architecting micro-service based cloud solutions Responsibilities Be Developer & Engineer that the team depends on tackle difficult problems, produce automation, and prove out abstract solutions. Create and provide long-term technical leadership and vision for teams by guiding other internal development teams on cloud architecture, engineering, and operational standards. Troubleshoot difficult cases, especially those involving full range of cloud, system, network problems, including helping other teams with systems that we did not build. Architect, build, and support systems in collaboration with other departments and colleagues Consider designs for long term, scale, resiliency, Cost, Security, and maintainability. Quickly learn new services as they come out of AWS, Azure and GCP. Work on a wide range of innovative Cloud uses cases. Create code-assets and tools to accelerate cloud projects. Will be an automation advocate - you genuinely believe in removing operation load with software. Ability to automate manual processes and write code to expediate detection and mitigation of issues in the environment. Work with other app-dev teams to develop new cloud hosted services Partner with service providers both internal and external to design and implement cloud data systems in the BMS cloud environment. Education and training of teams Document, Design/Build automation tools and APIs Educational, Professional, and Technical Expertise: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or commensurate experience. At least 5+ years of experience in cloud computing, software development and/or Cloud Center of Excellence (COE) as a hands-on coding role. At least 3+ years of experience working with AWS as a senior developer Strong knowledge of cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Willingness to occasionally work in a 24x7 on-call cycle to manage escalations. Strong verbal and written communication skills (content creation such as whitepapers, system diagrams, etc.). Ability to explain complex technology concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences at all levels in the organization. jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role The Anthropic Residency is our paid, fixed-term research program, with placements lasting between six weeks and six months. We are looking for people who have led ambitious work in a variety of technical fields and want to transition to full-time work focused on making sure AI systems are safe and beneficial for all of humanity. If you are a professor in a quantitative discipline, a technical founder or a staff-level engineer and want to transition to work on transformative AI, we want to hear from you. Background in machine learning is not required. What to expect A concrete, scoped project matched to your background, with direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers Access to Claude models and GPU compute Connection to the broader AI safety and security research community Interview process The interview process will include an initial application, recruiter screen, technical assessment, research discussion and a reference check. Applications for this round close on November 22, 2026 (11:59 PM PT). We expect to make offers in January 2027. You may be a good fit if you Are motivated by making sure AI is safe and beneficial for society as a whole Are excited to transition into working on empirical AI research full-time Have led ambitious work in a variety of technical fields (professor in a quantitative discipline, a technical founder or a staff-level engineer) Thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments Can implement ideas quickly and communicate clearly Strong candidates may also Have experience authoring research papers in machine learning, NLP, or AI safety Have experience with LLMs, reinforcement learning or Kubernetes clusters and complex shared codebases Mentors and research areas Potential Anthropic mentors include: Sara Price : leads the Alignment Training team; background in data science Ethan Perez : leads the Alignment Science team; background in machine learning Evan Hubinger : leads the Alignment Stress-Testing team; formerly at The Machine Intelligence Research Institute (MIRI) Samuel Marks : leads the Scalable Oversight team; background in mathematics Elana Simon : researches the interpretability of language models and biological models; background in biomedical informatics Belinda Li : researches how language models represent the world, users, and themselves; background in natural language processing (PhD, MIT) Jack Lindsey : leads the Model Psychology team; background in theoretical neuroscience Nicholas Carlini : researches adversarial machine learning and AI security; previously at DeepMind and Google Brain Jascha Sohl-Dickstein : works at the intersection of safety and pretraining; background in physics and neuroscience, formerly Principal Scientist at Google Brain Residents will work on empirical research questions in collaboration with Anthropic's research teams. Areas we are particularly interested in include: AI safety & alignment Scalable Oversight: Developing techniques to keep highly capable models helpful and honest, even as they surpass human-level intelligence in various domains. Adversarial Robustness and AI Control: Creating methods to ensure advanced AI systems remain safe and harmless in unfamiliar or adversarial scenarios. Model Organisms: Creating model organisms of misalignment to improve our empirical understanding of how alignment failures might arise. Model Internals and Interpretability: Advancing our understanding of the internal workings of large language models to enable more targeted interventions and safety measures. Safeguards Research: Developing robust defenses against adversarial attacks, comprehensive evaluation frameworks for model safety, and automated systems to detect and mitigate potential risks before deployment. AI Welfare: Improving our understanding of potential AI welfare and developing related evaluations and mitigations. AI security & frontier red-teaming Stress-testing frontier models to understand the full extent of their current capabilities in fields such as cybersecurity, robotics or cryptography. ML systems & reinforcement learning Improving how frontier models are trained and building the infrastructure behind that research, from model architecture, optimizers and training data to accelerator simulators, hardware backends and RL environment pipelines. For a fuller picture of the questions we care about, see our Recommendations for Technical AI Safety Research Directions and recent publications from our Alignment , Interpretability and Frontier Red teams. Logistics Duration: Placements are six weeks, three months or six months, depending on team fit and candidate preferences. Other lengths between three and six months are possible by exception. Location: We prefer that Residents work from our San Francisco office, where most of our research staff is based, but remote participation is possible, especially for shorter placements. Most full-time research roles at Anthropic require relocation to San Francisco. Remote participants need to be based in a country where Anthropic can hire. Commitment: Full-time role for the duration of the residency. Compensation: $350,000 to $500,000/year pro-rated for the duration of the residency + benefits Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas for placements of three months or longer. For six-week placements we encourage remote participation from a country where Anthropic can hire. Applicants may also be considered for the Anthropic Fellows Program . The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $350,000 — $500,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.

Efficiency and Innovation: Champion automation, templated workflows, and platform creation to reduce manual effort and external vendor reliance, maximizing reuse and operational efficiency. Product KPIs & enablement: Define and track product KPIs—adoption, activation, retention, and model accuracy vs. business lift—and build training content, enablement, and adoption playbooks to drive sustained usage and value realization. Extensive knowledge of pharmaceutical data (claims, APLD, specialty pharmacy, digital signals, promotional data). Product management/product owner (PM/PO) certification (e.g., CSPO, SAFe PO/PM, Pragmatic Institute) a plus. Core Competencies Outstanding stakeholder engagement and communication skills—capable of translating complex analytics concepts into actionable business strategies. Strong project management and interpersonal skills, with the ability to lead diverse teams and manage multiple competing priorities. Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize insights from disparate data sources. Strategic mindset with a passion for hands-on, AI-led innovation and continuous improvement. Develop algorithms and tools to support new products, including contributions to the production bioinformatics pipeline. Act as an internal technical consultant on bioinformatics methodology for other functional groups. Work closely with assay development, engineering, biostatistics, clinical, commercial, regulatory, and lab operations teams. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Agentic Discovery
jobs.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: London, UK Engineering Manager, Agentic Discovery About the Department Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization. About the Team We build the products that enable the next era of the Internet: making domains Readable , Discoverable , and Callable for autonomous AI agents. Here at Cloudflare, agentic discovery is a core part of our vision for the Agentic Internet . As AI agents change how humans and machines find, evaluate, and act on information, businesses need tools to control how they are represented and reached. We build capabilities that enable website owners to prepare their sites for agent interaction, test and observe how agents read their content, establish open interaction standards (like WebMCP), and create entirely new channels to reach agentic audiences. We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard. About the Role We are looking for an Engineering Manager to build and lead the engineering team across our Agentic Discovery portfolio. You will be responsible for the people, execution, and engineering quality behind customer-facing products that help businesses manage how AI agents understand, represent, and interact with their digital properties. You will partner closely with Product Management and engineering teams across Cloudflare to shape priorities around Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), content ingestion/indexing, agent observation and testing tools, and open tool-execution standards (such as WebMCP and Generative UI). This is a management role for someone who is deeply technically credible. You will not be expected to write most of the code, but you should be able to understand the systems your engineers operate, challenge architectural decisions around distributed systems and web-scale data pipelines, ask the right questions when something is going wrong, and step into a technical problem when the situation calls for it. At the same time, we are looking for a manager, not a tech lead with direct reports. Your success will be measured by the quality and output of the team you build, the engineers you develop, and the systems and products they deliver. This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed. What you'll do Manage, coach, and grow engineers working across customer-facing Agentic Discovery products, AEO tooling, and agent-web interaction standards. Own execution by establishing clear priorities, creating predictable delivery, and giving engineers the context and autonomy to own meaningful areas of the product. Lead the development of tools enabling Cloudflare customers to make their content Readable (structured content transformation), Discoverable (indexing, directories, and AEO), and Callable (WebMCP, APIs, Generative UI) for autonomous agents. Build tools for customers to test, observe, measure, and control how AI agents find and interact with their websites and applications. Partner closely with Product Management to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn broad opportunities into clear engineering outcomes. Identify how Cloudflare's global network and edge signals can enable unique products that help businesses reach trusted agentic audiences at scale. Balance near-term product delivery with thoughtful technical investments that allow promising ideas to grow. Own the operational health of the systems in your area, including observability, incident response, data quality, and long-term reliability. Develop technical leaders and create space for engineers to lead architecture and implementation. Responsibilities We want you to love it here. This role is a great fit for you if: You have led and developed a high-performing engineering team(s) and can point to what that team shipped and how the people on it grew. You are technically credible with experienced engineers. You can review a design, understand the trade-offs in distributed systems or web-scale data pipelines, and recognize when a technical problem needs deeper investigation. You are comfortable managing a team working across several related technical areas (such as search/indexing, protocol standards, and UI engineering) and can create clarity without requiring every problem to fit neatly into a single box. You care deeply about reliability and quality, particularly when the output of a system is data that users and AI agents rely on to navigate the Internet. You have strong product judgment and enjoy working with Product Management to decide what is worth building, what needs improvement, and what should not be built at all. You are comfortable with ambiguity and with finding structure in areas where the opportunity is clearer than the roadmap. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and can explain complex technical decisions to both engineers and non-engineers. Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience Strong technical grounding in distributed systems, web-scale data platforms, agentic architectures, Internet infrastructure, or adjacent areas. Experience building customer-facing products involving content indexing, crawling, analytics, or complex user interaction patterns. Experience operating systems where correctness, data quality, and reliability matter as much as feature delivery. A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers. Experience partnering closely with Product Management to shape and execute a roadmap. Experience taking products or major capabilities from an ambiguous opportunity to a clear customer outcome. Strong written and verbal communication. Bonus Points Hands-on familiarity with emerging agentic technologies and standards such as WebMCP, AEO, and Generative UI. Experience building products for AI developers, AI agents, publishers, or content-heavy websites. Experience working with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platforms, search/indexing, or testing and observability platforms. Experience turning complex underlying internet systems or data into intuitive, high-value products for a broad audience. What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. jobs.description: Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. This work spans context engineering i.e making guidelines, examples, and documentation useful to AI, agent architecture improvements as well as creating datasets, evaluators, and benchmarks that show how well outputs follow a customer's design system. You'll set strategy across these areas, raise the bar on adherence measurement, and turn evaluation results and customer feedback into feedback loops that make design quality better. This is a high-impact opportunity to shape Figma's Agent and improve overall design quality. An organization’s Design System is one of the key differentiators of design quality as we can use it to make agent output adhere to their specific brand, products and design language. We are also aiming to solve Design <> Code parity and minimize drift away from the defined design system in both code and designs. This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States. Reporting to the Employer Brand Manager, you’ll help translate our employer brand strategy into stories and campaigns that help candidates understand our work, our people, and the opportunity to contribute to our mission. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad employer brand responsibilities and a particular focus on writing, content planning, digital, and social storytelling. You’ll develop content that reflects the experiences of our researchers and employees, adapt stories for different audiences and channels, and help deliver a consistent, credible candidate experience. You’ll work closely with Recruiting, Marketing & Brand, Internal Communications, the broader People team, employees, hiring managers, and external partners to bring projects from idea through publication and measurement. cold_email.subject: Interest in Employer Brand, Communications & Social — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear OpenAI Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Employer Brand, Communications & Social opportunity with OpenAI at OpenAI.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Traffic Infrastructure
jobs.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Cloud Infrastructure team builds and operates the infrastructure behind OpenAI’s products, including ChatGPT and the API. Within Cloud Infrastructure, the Traffic team owns how traffic enters our cloud environments, moves between services, clusters, and regions, and reaches external dependencies. Our work spans cloud networking, Kubernetes networking, ingress and egress gateways, proxies, load balancing, and traffic steering. We build the systems, controls, and observability that make these paths reliable, secure, efficient, and straightforward for other engineering teams to use. ABOUT THE ROLE You’ll build and operate the networking and traffic infrastructure that connects OpenAI’s products and services across clouds and regions. The team’s work spans L3, L4, and L7—from IP connectivity, NAT, and transport behavior to service proxies and application request routing. You’ll bring depth in part of this stack and curiosity about how the whole path works. Projects may include building gateways and control planes, improving cross-region connectivity, diagnosing packet loss or connection exhaustion, and making routing changes safer and easier to operate. This role combines software engineering with production ownership. You’ll turn ambiguous networking problems into durable improvements, working closely with service owners, infrastructure teams, Security, and cloud providers. This role is based in San Francisco, CA or Seattle, WA. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Design, build, and operate ingress, egress, and service-to-service connectivity across clusters, regions, and clouds. - Develop proxies, gateways, controllers, and automation for routing, load balancing, failover, and traffic management. - Build and evolve cloud networking infrastructure, including private connectivity, NAT, and network isolation. - Diagnose failures and performance bottlenecks across application, proxy, transport, and cloud networking layers; work with cloud providers when issues extend into their infrastructure. - Build telemetry and diagnostic tools that explain traffic paths, identify failing components, and help engineers take effective action. - Partner with Security to implement and validate traffic-path protections, including secure service communication, access controls, egress restrictions, and DDoS defenses. - Improve latency, throughput, availability, and network efficiency through measurement, testing, and careful production rollouts. - Create clear interfaces and safe defaults for service teams, participate in on-call, and turn operational lessons into changes that prevent recurring failures and reduce manual work. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have 5+ years of experience building production infrastructure or distributed systems, including substantial work on networking or traffic infrastructure. - Have depth in one or more areas such as cloud networking, Kubernetes networking, proxies and gateways, service meshes, load balancing, or global traffic routing. - Understand networking fundamentals and can reason about how IP routing, TCP/UDP, DNS, NAT, TLS, and HTTP/gRPC affect connectivity and performance. - Have hands-on experience building or operating systems such as Envoy, NGINX, Istio, Cilium, or comparable networking infrastructure. - Write production software in Go, Rust, C++, Python, or a similar language, and use software and automation to solve operational problems. - Can investigate unfamiliar failures using evidence, test hypotheses, and follow problems through to a verified resolution. - Take ownership of design, implementation, rollout, and ongoing reliability, and communicate clearly across teams when a problem crosses ownership boundaries. - Care about making infrastructure secure and understandable for the engineers who depend on it. We value deep expertise and the willingness to learn across boundaries. You do not need prior experience with every technology or networking layer listed above. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES Verifies test requisitions by comparing information with nursing station log; bringing discrepancies to the attention of unit personnel. Verifies patient by reading patient identification. Obtains blood specimens by performing venipunctures and finger sticks. Maintains specimen integrity by using aseptic technique, following department procedures; observing isolation procedures. Tracks collected specimens by initialing, dating, and noting times of collection; maintaining daily tallies of collections performed. Maintains quality results by following department procedures and testing schedule; recording results in the quality-control log; identifying and reporting needed changes. Maintains safe, secure, and healthy work environment by following standards and procedures; complying with legal regulations. Resolves unusual test orders by contacting the physician, pathologist, nursing station, or reference laboratory; referring unresolved orders back to the originator for further clarification; notifying supervisor of unresolved orders. Updates job knowledge by participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations. Enhances phlebotomy department and hospital reputation by accepting ownership for accomplishing new and different requests; exploring opportunities to add value to job accomplishments. This role works with PHI on a regular basis both in paper and electronic form and have an access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) in order to perform the job Employee must complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as soon as possible but not later than the first 30 days of hire. Must maintain a current status on Natera training requirements Logistical management/printing of patient reports for that area Billing question answering/triaging and follow-up with patients Scheduling pick ups from courier services - FedEx or Medspeed. QUALIFICATIONS Minimum of 5 years of phlebotomy experience BS/BA degree (preferred) High School Diploma (or equivalent) required Phlebotomy Certificate (if required by State) KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES Ability to serve and protect the hospital community by adhering to professional standards, hospital policies and procedures, federal, state, and local requirements, and JCAHO standards. PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT Work in an office setting with scrubs required The position requires tracking of each draw OUR OPPORTUNITY Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. cold_email.subject: Interest in Sr Phlebotomist-Part Time - Mt. Airy, NC — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Natera Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Sr Phlebotomist-Part Time - Mt. Airy, NC opportunity with Natera at Natera.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
